label: Config
info: Shared settings of the flows, stored in global context.

name: [1] CONFIG
info: STAGE 1 - CONFIG. The shared settings of ALL flows live in node 1.1 CONFIG, the only node to edit: the platform (legacy or xcelerator, no default: set one), root folder, credentials, sites (report source, production-day start, lines with their ids from stage 2), exclusions. From the platform it builds the token address and the API addresses that every request node uses. It stores them in global context (glob.get("cfg")). It runs on deploy and when you click Apply. After a change, click Apply, then run the flow you want to test.

name: 1.1 CONFIG (edit here)
[2] SIH ASSET LIST
info: STAGE 2 - click "List SIH assets" to see every Insights Hub line with its id, so you can fill the lines of 1.1 CONFIG. Uses the credentials and platform of 1.1 (click Apply first). Token request, OEE asset list, one message per asset (one per second, about a minute for 60 assets). Read calls only, nothing is written.

name: 2.1 Start asset list
2.2 Build token request
2.3 Build asset list request
2.4 Make one item per asset
[3] ASSET PATHS
info: STAGE 3 - one Asset Management call per asset (hierarchyPath: site, area, line), a join collects all assets, then the Machine Names check of stage 4 starts.

name: 3.1 Build asset request
3.2 Shape asset path
3.3 Start Machine Names check
[4] MACHINE NAMES
info: STAGE 4 - one message per site of 1.1 CONFIG (the assets travel along in msg.assets): the folder <root>/reference/machine_names/site=<Site>/ is listed, the newest .csv is read and parsed, and its MachineName values are kept. A site without a file gives a failed item (a problem in the list). Read calls only.

name: 4.1 Set site folder
4.2 Pick the file
4.3 Take machine names
[5] ASSET LIST
info: STAGE 5 - the join waits for the Machine Names of all sites, then it builds the list in the debug node ASSET LIST: problems (a Config line id not found, renamed in Insights Hub, in another site, or a Config report name that is not a MachineName of the Machine Names file of the site; a site without a Machine Names file), one line per Insights Hub line (path, auto or manual, id, number of machines, the report name) and, per site, a block to paste into the lines of 1.1 CONFIG with the report name found in the Machine Names file (same letters and digits), or report "?" with the close names (same first word, or all names of a site with at most 12) when none matches. Lines below Test Line (excludeAncestorNames) are left out.

name: 5.1 Build asset list
